title: Indian-Style Ham and Cheese Naan
description: A delicious and easy-to-make naan bread dish featuring ham and melted cheese, inspired by Indian flavors. Perfect for a quick snack or light meal.
instructions: Preheat a non-stick pan or griddle over medium heat.
Place a naan bread piece in the pan and brush with curry sauce.
Top with a few slices of Parma Ham and sprinkle with mozzarella cheese.
Fold the naan bread in half to enclose the filling.
Cook for 2-3 minutes or until the cheese is melted and the bread is crispy.
Flip the naan bread over and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Garnish with chopped cilantro and serve immediately.
